policy: Compare evidenced lethal front/head/body routes by measured response; precise mouths and broad explosive saturation have different acquisition costs.
cost_basis: All precise-part routes pay acquisition cost regardless of weapon penetration. Twofold is a provisional engineering value for ordinary head/gap aim; no hit probability, damage or ammunition penalty.
precise_minimum_basis: User requires at least fourfold acquisition time for Bile Spewer specific-part aim, with a higher fivefold minimum for its mouth. Broad explosive abdomen saturation is not precise-part aim.

user_checks.statement: User confirms all non-Main parts are explosion-immune and usual Scorcher consumption is six to eight shots. This is a validation range, not a damage override or instant threat-removal claim.

bile_spewer:head.evidence: Large unarmored fatal abdomen is visible from front/side/rear and has 100 percent durability but 0 percent ExDR. User confirms broad explosive saturation is a practical fast route. This is not a promise that every armor plate has identical BTK.

alpha_commander:head.evidence: Main is listed as a front/side damage zone with AV2, 70 percent durability and no constitution. Compare direct body destruction against head break plus residual bleed; never force waiting when the same weapon has a quicker body route.

hive_guard:head.evidence: Wiki tactics explicitly describes hitting Main through the frontal gap, including while crouched; Main has 0 percent ExDR.

bile_spewer:head.cost_basis: User-specified minimum of fivefold precise-mouth acquisition time; this is a time cost, not measured accuracy.
bile_spewer:head.evidence: Wiki describes the unarmored mouth as optimal for light penetration; it is fatal with 100 percent ExDR. Redirected blast damage to Main is not counted as mouth damage.
